summary: Crash in gfxFont::GetGlyph with null font entry dereference during canvas text measurement
description: Firefox crashes when measuring text in OffscreenCanvas if font fallback fails to locate a valid system font face under high concurrency. The pointer `fontEntry` is assumed non-null after `FindFontEntry()` without an assertion or conditional branch.
stack_trace:
0  xul.dll!gfxFont::GetGlyph(unsigned int) [gfxFont.cpp:412]
1  xul.dll!gfxTextRun::MeasureText(gfxTextRun::PropertyProvider*) [gfxTextRun.cpp:984]
2  xul.dll!mozilla::dom::CanvasRenderingContext2D::MeasureText(nsTSubstring<char16_t> const&) [CanvasRenderingContext2D.cpp:2871]
3  xul.dll!mozilla::dom::CanvasRenderingContext2D_Binding::measureText_promise(JSContext*, JS::Handle<JSObject*>, void*, JSJitMethodCallArgs const&) [CanvasRenderingContext2D.cpp:5810]
comments: Observed on Windows 10/11 x64 builds. Adding an early null check against mFontEntry resolves the access violation.

summary: NS_ERROR_NET_RESET on HTTP/2 stream multiplexing when server closes TCP RST before EOS frame
description: During heavy pipelined asset retrieval over HTTP/2, if the remote CDN terminates an inactive stream with RST_STREAM NO_ERROR, the socket reader drops existing frames and signals an unhandled abort to higher layer channel listeners.
comments: Fixed by buffering partial stream payloads and deferring stream destruction until pending frames finish dispatch.

summary: WarpBuilder assertion failure: TypeDescr Mismatch during polymorphic inline cache optimization
description: WarpBuilder crashes in debug builds when compiling an optimized megamorphic property access for frozen prototype chains. The compiler expects known object shape representations but encounters unboxed record layouts.
stack_trace:
Assertion failure: expected != nullptr (Invalid Shape Representation in WarpBuilder), at js/src/jit/WarpBuilder.cpp:1423
#01: js::jit::WarpBuilder::buildGetProperty(js::jit::BytecodeLocation) [js/src/jit/WarpBuilder.cpp:1425]

#03: js::jit::CompileBackEnd(js::jit::MIRGenerator*) [js/src/jit/Ion.cpp:1740]
comments: Patch adds fallback de-optimization pathway when unboxed prototype objects are encountered in Warp.

summary: CORS preflight request headers stripped when navigating redirected sandboxed iframe
description: When an iframe sandbox has `allow-scripts` but omits `allow-same-origin`, redirected preflight OPTIONS requests fail because Authorization headers are omitted by the network security manager.
stack_trace:
nsCORSListenerProxy::UpdateChannel() failed with NS_ERROR_DOM_BAD_URI at nsCORSListenerProxy.cpp:640
mozilla::net::nsHttpChannel::AsyncOpen() at nsHttpChannel.cpp:1340
comments: Preserved origin headers under CORS redirect specifications per WHATWG fetch standard.
